notes.title: Cantaloupe Chronicle - Available now!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]with great pleasure I announce that my newest game "Cantaloupe Chronicle" is now available on Steam for Windows and Linux.[/p][p][/p][p]In [i]Cantaloupe Chronicle[/i], you step into the shoes of a budding journalist on your first day as an intern at the town’s quirky newspaper, [i]The Cantaloupe Chronicle[/i]. Set in a cozy roadside town filled with intrigue, this game invites you to explore a rich, atmospheric environment. Interact with eccentric locals, solve puzzles, and uncover stories that will shape your career as a reporter.[/p][p]The story centers on an old mystery, but the theme explores how not every story ends cleanly and how we learn to live without closure.[/p][p]What begins as a simple learning experience quickly turns into a quest to uncover the secrets of the town's past—including the mysterious case of a body found years ago.[/p][p]As you collect items, talk to the townsfolk, and solve engaging puzzles, you’ll craft articles using an innovative text editor system. Writing doesn’t feel daunting here—you can unlock text blocks from your investigations and insert them into articles with ease. From small-town gossip to the big front-page story, every article brings them closer to the ultimate truth.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p] Tim[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.1 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to announce a new update... and it's a rather big one. :)

New features:
-Completely reworked how you select weapons during combat to be much less confusing
-Recreated all random combat areas. They are now much smaller and more action-packed. No more endless searching for ants!
-30+ bug-fixes small to medium

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43112224/b90c297ee68365042eb46ae33fbc776fbbb5fd2f.png[/img]

Have fun! :)

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello,

I've just deployed a small bug-fix that could cause weapons to get lost during combat when you put them away.

Cheers

notes.title: New Update with New Features
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've just released a new update for the game with some nice QoL features:
[list]
[*]If you send one of your party members to recruit others and there's already a person available to recruit you will now get notified and get a marker on the map where you have to go.
[*]When you press 'escape' during combat you can now flee the fight. This is only possible of no ants are in visible range and you won't get any town alertness.
[*]When you stash a weapon during combat that you don't have any ammunition for you will now always get the fist as an active weapon. Thus the empty weapon doesn't block the weapon slot anymore.
[*]Several smaller bug-fixes
[/list]

Enjoy! :)

notes.title: Update: Game now Playable on the Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to tell you that the game is now "playable" on the Steam Deck. You should encounter no problems while playing through the game. (Note: the game is not completely optimized for controller play and the best experience is still to play with mouse and keyboard.)

Other changes:
-Added notification animation on closed upper menu to make new notifications more visible
-Small improvements in combat controls and edge-casses
-Minor bug-fixes

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
By popular demand I've added the following features:
[list]
[*] You can now zoom out on the map with the mouse scroll wheel or by pressing space.
[*] The settings are now also available from the pause menu.
[*] Stashing a weapon no longer consumes an action point. Rather you can't stash a weapon when you have no action points left. This should be more intuitive behavior.
[/list]

And a few minor fixes and corrected typos.

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.notes:

[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't click on locations if you saved on the town map

[*] Fixed a bug where you would never hit an enemy with a Rock
